question: After __________, Virat Kohli is the second Indian cricket captain to win two test matches in a series in England.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Dev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kapil Dev was the 1st captain to win two test matches in England in **1986**.

 
 
• He was also the **1st captain** to win the **world cup for India** in **1983**.
 
• He is also known as the **"Haryana Hurricane"**.
 
• He made his debut in international cricket on **October 16, 1978, against Pakistan**.
 
 
 
• Virat Kohli is now the 2nd captain to win two test matches in England.
